mods.name: LazyMC Total Levels Tracker 1.21.11 Fabric
mods.description: Tracks a per-player lifetime total of all XP ever earned, completely independent of the player's current XP - only positive gains (orbs picked up, /xp add ... points, trading, etc.) ever add to it, nothing ever subtracts, so death, enchanting, and anvil use never touch it. /totallevels converts that lifetime total back into 'the level you'd be at if it had never been spent or lost', using the inverse of vanilla's level-to-XP curve. Stored as one small JSON file per player under the world save folder, not in vanilla player data.

releases.notes:
## 1.0.0 - Initial release

- Track per-player lifetime XP totals
- `/totallevels` command to display lifetime level equivalent
- Stored as JSON per player in world save folder
